sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 4 Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of Office Amendment Order 2001
sections.description:
Short Title and Commencement

APPOINTMENT OF PROVINCILA MINISTERS AND OATH OF OFFICE (AMMENDMENT)
ORDER, 2001
APPOINTMENT OF PROVINCILA MINISTERS AND OATH OF OFFICE
(AMMENDMENT) ORDER, 2001
CHIEF EXECUTIVE S ORDER 4 OF 2001
An Order
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part, I, 28th June, 2001]
No. 2-29/99-Min-II, dated
28-6-2001. To amend the Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of Office
Order, 1999 (Chief Executive Order NO. 8 of 1999)
1. Short Title and
Commencement;---(1) This order may balled the Appointment of Provincial
Ministers and Oath of Office (Amendment) Order, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

An Order

Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part, I, 28th June, 2001]
No. 2-29/99-Min-II, dated
28-6-2001. To amend the Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of Office
Order, 1999 (Chief Executive Order NO. 8 of 1999)
2. Amendment of Article 11, Chief Executive s Order No. 8
of 1999.--- in the Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of office
Order, 1999 (Chief Executive s Order No. 8 of 1999), in Article 11, after the
words Chief Executive occurring for the first time, the words or any order
made by the Governor with the prior approval of the Chief Executive occurring
at the end shall be omitted.
